crossRefs.note: The troubles of my heart are enlarged. Oh bring me out of my distresses.
Consider my affliction and my travail. Forgive all my sins.
Then Jesus came with them to a place called Gethsemane, and said to his disciples, “Sit here, while I go there and…
Hurry to help me, Lord, my salvation.
Hurry, God, to deliver me. Come quickly to help me, Yahweh.

translations.web: Be pleased, Yahweh, to deliver me. Hurry to help me, Yahweh.
translations.bsb: Be pleased, O LORD, to deliver me; hurry, O LORD, to help me.
translations.kjv: Be pleased, O LORD, to deliver me: O LORD, make haste to help
translations.asv: Be pleased, O Jehovah, to deliver me: Make haste to help me, O Jehovah.
